title: CLIHistoryEntrySchema
description: Google Antigravity CLI prompt history line entry schema (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/history.jsonl).

display.description: Prompt text or slash command string submitted by user.

timestamp.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of prompt submission.

workspace.description: Absolute path to workspace directory where prompt was executed.

conversationId.description: Unique conversation ID associated with this interaction.
